rows.output: {"message": "Alright, Edrick. Down five already, huh. Let's see if I can make this interesting."}
{"message": "Five to nothing, huh. Enjoy it while it lasts, man. Let's see if it holds."}
{"message": "Up five already, huh. Alright, gonna toss a Knight at you and see if it sticks."}
{"message": "Okay. Shaking that off. Let's just... play."}
{"message": "Okay. You said that like you meant it. Alright, I'm listening now."}
{"message": "Hm. Down early again. Okay, I've been here before. Give me a second to breathe."}
{"message": "Oof. Knight tramples Ogre. Yeah, that tracks. Okay, your round."}
{"message": "Okay, Knight first. You meant it this time, huh. 0-5, noted."}
{"message": "Ouch. Your Knight just walked right through my guy. Okay, okay. Note taken."}
